name: run-policy
description: The performance-law exports of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs, and their Jet twin, the Policy module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/Policy.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver with one command per export: the ratified strict performance policy, the machine-ceiling policy and the loss-owner category of each metric; the issues of the repository's matrix (none), of a matrix whose policy departs from the ratified one in every checked way, of one with no area lists and of one with no policy; the issues of the repository's asm-parity references (none), of references with duplicate, missing and unknown names and cells, and of a file that is not a list; the peers of every cell of the repository's matrix and of matrices with sparse and odd rails; whether a metric applies to a language, by own, every-metric and whole-language facts (valid and invalid) and by the script web rails' missing Wasm binary; the verdict of each of a list of ratios; and an unknown command (exit 64).
